title: November 2026 refresh and site update
items: Added 11 trackers. Policy: Epstein Becker Green State AI Law Tracker, NYU State Technology Policy Report, IAPP AI Legal Ethics and Responsibilities Tracker, ICMA AI Regulatory Developments Tracker, TFL AI Legislation Tracker. Litigation: AI Hallucination Cases Database, Tech Litigation Tracker (TRAL), McKool Smith AI Litigation Tracker, AI Lawsuit Tracker, Fisher Phillips AI Litigation Tracker, CMS AI and Copyright Case Tracker.
Status changes: Brennan Center back to Active; BakerHostetler and AI Standards Hub marked Stale.
Corrected the Council of Europe AI convention entry (not yet in force) and the EU AI Act high-risk date (December 2027 after the Omnibus). Refreshed counts and dates on about 35 entries.
New on the site: a Litigation & Enforcement tab, filters by jurisdiction and topic, links that reopen any view or tracker, CSV and JSON downloads, published inclusion criteria, and this changelog.

title: July 2026 refresh
items: Full accuracy review of every entry. The catalog grew from 52 to 84 trackers.

Added regional trackers (Africa AI Policy Tool, ILIA, the LatAm AI Regulation Repository, SEA AI Observatory), EU AI Act trackers, government algorithm registers, incident databases, and AI company safety scorecards.
Removed Husch Blackwell (tracker page retired). AGORA returned as a living archive, and the TAG Register was marked Stale.
This refresh was published in November along with the next one.
